QuestInfo.name: South Sanctum Duty
QuestInfo.0: There was nothing special at the South Sanctum, and you helped out #p3000005# while you were at it. But as you were leaving, you sensed that evil aura again. The Nefarious Priests must be nearby!
QuestInfo.1:
You found the Nefarious Priests gathered at the back of South Sanctum. Defeat them! 


#b#eIf you fail the quest, you can forfeit it and start it again.#n#k
QuestInfo.2: You have returned to South Sanctum after defeating the Nefarious Priests. You should let\r\n#p3000005# know about this. After all, she gets\r\nstartled easily.

1.0: Kaiser! Are you all right? I heard something noisy back there. What is going on?

yes.0: What? Nefarious Priests at the back of the Sanctum? Boy...I'm glad you were here.
yes.1: You've been a huge help, Kaiser. Thank you!

default.0: Still here? I guess you just can't bear to leave...
